chunks: Al-Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad al-Baṣrī narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Salamah, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Ḥakam, from his father, from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr, from Ibn ʿAbbās, who said:

The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: Indeed, ʿAlī عليه السلام is my legatee and my successor, and his wife Fāṭimah, the leader of the women of the worlds, is my daughter; and al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn, the leaders of the youth of the people of Paradise, are my two sons.

Whoever befriends them has befriended me; whoever opposes them has opposed me; whoever shows hostility to them has shown hostility to me; whoever shuns them has shunned me; and whoever is dutiful to them has been dutiful to me. Allah joins whoever joins them, cuts off whoever cuts them off, supports whoever aids them, and forsakes whoever forsakes them.

O Allah, for whoever among Your Prophets and Messengers had a weighty trust and a household, then ʿAlī, Fāṭimah, al-Ḥasan, and al-Ḥusayn are my Ahl al-Bayt and my weighty trust. So remove impurity from them and purify them with a thorough purification, O Lord of the worlds.

key_terms.ثَقَلِي: my weighty trust or precious legacy
key_terms.سَيِّدَا شَبَابِ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ: the two leaders of the youth of the people of Paradise
key_terms.سَيِّدَةُ نِسَاءِ الْعَالَمِينَ: the foremost lady among the women of the worlds
key_terms.وَصِيِّي: my legatee; the one entrusted with succession after me

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the status of ʿAlī, Fāṭimah, al-Ḥasan, and al-Ḥusayn as the Prophet’s Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms the special rank of ʿAlī عليه السلام, Fāṭimah عليها السلام, al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, and al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام as the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم Ahl al-Bayt. It links loyalty to them with loyalty to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and includes a supplication for their purification and distinction.
